evidence: The reaction of titanium tetrachloride with products formed by thermally induced transformations of basic magnesium carbonate was studied at 200 /G6FC on a thermogravimetric setup with a quartz spring balance with the spring stretching factor of 3.33 mg g /G331. With 0.10 /G330.12-g samples, this allows monitoring to within /G2B0.5 mg g /G331 of mass changes under conditions of a continuous supply of reagent vapor and removal of gaseous reaction products.
